cactus: Flower crown, spine halo & gold pot
lily: Triple spathe fan, halo & gold pot
wisteria: Longer cascades & a vine on the pot
Blossom arch, falling petals & gold pot
plantbulb: A tulip bud on a tall stem
Open tulip, sun rays & gold pot
book: Gold corners, a gilded title & a longer ribbon
Fanned pages, a brass clasp & a floating rune
ink: Ink splotches, a tucked quill & flying drops
A golden nib crown & a sweeping flourish
candle: A warm glow, a ribbon band & a brass handle
Two more flames on a brass candelabra & drifting embers
teapot: A flowered band & steam from the spout
Gold trim, a steam crown & a fine saucer
jelly: A moon clover, a tide ring & glowing tendrils
shroom: Baby mushrooms sprout at its feet
A fairy ring, a flower crown & glowing spores
snail: A mossy shell with a flower & a dewdrop
A tiny castle on its shell & a golden spiral
axolotl: Golden gill tips, a tide ring & a heart
owl: Great wings, a starred cap & a floating book
star: A golden burst & a crown of little stars
lizard: A colour fan frill & bright toe pads
Little wings, a golden spike crest & sparks
frog: A lily pad hat with a flower & dewdrops
A royal crown, a cape & a lily pad stage
capy: A yuzu on its head & a happy hum
A towel, a hot spring & gentle steam
polar: An ice crown, the northern lights & frost
panda: A bamboo shoot & a fresh leaf
A bamboo grove, a blossom crown & a red sash
penguin: A red scarf & a fish snack
Golden cheeks, a crown & a royal cape
hamster: A spinning wheel & a gold medal
koala: A gum leaf crown & a leaf snack
A cosy branch, blossoms & falling leaves

book: Read me! I promise I have a twist ending. 📕
I am mostly pages and a little bit of glue.
My cover got harder. My heart did not. 💛
Bookmark me, I am at a good part!
Every page in me glows a little now. ✨
I have chapters you have not unlocked yet. 📖
ink: I wrote my name! It is a smudge.
I can do cursive now. Fancy! ✒️
Every story starts with a drop of me.
Let me sign your reading log with a flourish. ✍️
My nib crown is pure gold, darling.
candle: I make the cosiest reading light. 🕯️
Shh, my flame is listening to your book.
One more chapter? I can stay lit.
Three flames for three more chapters! 🕯️🕯️🕯️
I light the way through any spooky story.
teapot: I am short and stout and full of stories.
A Grand Teapot always has a saucer ready. ☕
Steeping wisdom, one page at a time.
jelly: My tentacles can hold six books!
I glow when the plot gets good. ✨
Bubbles mean I am excited. Blub blub!
The moon told me to keep reading. 🌙
I drift where the tide of the story goes.
shroom: I pop up wherever someone reads. 🍄
My spots are freckles. Do not count them.
My little shroom friends want a story too! 🍄
Step into my fairy ring for a magical tale. ✨
snail: I carry my cosy reading nook on my back.
I built a little castle up here. Want a tour? 🏰
Kingdoms are built one slow page at a time.
axolotl: Hehe, my gills wiggle when I am happy. 🌸
I am smiling. I am always smiling.
A smile a day keeps the boredom away.
owl: I stay up late for the good books.
I graduated from Picture Book Academy! 🎓
Did you know owls can turn their heads almost all the way around? Not me. Too dizzy.
I have catalogued every book you own. 📚
Wisdom is just a lot of reading. Hoo knew?
star: I fell from the sky into your story!
Make a wish on me! Mine is more books. 🌠
I zoom through chapters at light speed.
I shine brightest after a great ending. 💫
lizard: I lick my eyes to keep them clean. Is that weird? 🦎
My toes stick to anything. Even boring books.
I change colour when the story gets exciting.
I am basically a dragon now. A small one. 🐉
My wings work best during fantasy books.
frog: Ribbit! That means read in frog. 🐸
I used to have a tail. Long story.
My lily pad hat is very fashionable. 🌸
I hop from book to book!
Kiss me? No thanks, I like being a frog prince. 👑
capy: I am very calm. Very, very calm.
There is a yuzu on my head and I am at peace. 🍊
Chill vibes and a good book.
Hot spring plus a book equals perfect day. ♨️
Relax. The story will wait for you.
polar: I love stories about snow days.
Grandma knitted my scarf. Do you like it? 🧣
Snuggle up, it is reading weather.
The northern lights dance when you read. 🌌
panda: Nom nom bamboo. Nom nom books. 🐼
I roll when I am happy. Wheee!
This bamboo shoot is my reading snack. 🎋
Pandas read slowly and chew carefully.
The bamboo grove whispers old stories. 🎋
A calm mind reads the deepest books.
penguin: I cannot fly but I can read! 🐧
Fish for dinner, books for dessert. 🐟
My scarf keeps my beak toasty.
Emperors read in a very fancy way. 👑
Bow to the Emperor of the Ice Library.
hamster: I stuff snacks in my cheeks for long chapters.
My cheeks are full! Mmph mmph. 🌻
I saved a seed for you. Do you want it?
I ran a whole marathon in my wheel! 🏅
Gold medal reader, reporting for duty!
koala: I hug books like I hug trees.
Gum leaves make the best bookmarks. 🌿
I nap 20 hours and read the other 4.
From my branch I can see every story. 🌳
Old koala, slow reader, big heart.
